descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato* della produzione agricola e desideri svolgere un ruolo chiave nella catena del valore della divisione avicola? Unisciti a Micarna, un'azienda del gruppo Migros. La tua missione consisterà nel garantire l'approvvigionamento, la trasformazione e il benessere animale rispettando le normative legali e gli obiettivi strategici dell'azienda.

Mansioni
- Dirigi il settore agricolo della catena del valore aggiunto "polli" (riproduttori, incubatoi, ingrasso) implementando gli obiettivi fissati.
- Garantisci l'approvvigionamento del macello con polli vivi in base alle esigenze di vendita, rispettando le normative legali e i requisiti di benessere animale.
- Trasformi le risorse messe a disposizione in conformità con la strategia aziendale per ottimizzare i risultati e i rendimenti.
- Instauri e sviluppi un rapporto di partnership professionale con gli allevatori e sei responsabile del benessere degli animali secondo le direttive interne e le norme ufficiali vigenti.
- Definisci obiettivi in base alle esigenze dei clienti e dell'azienda.

Requisiti
- 5-10 anni: Esperienza comprovata in una posizione simile richiesta.
- Studi completati (Uni/EFP, HES, ES): Diploma di tecnico agroalimentare o formazione equivalente.
- Francese (Buona padronanza) Tedesco (Ottima conoscenza): Madrelingua francese o tedesca con eccellente conoscenza dell'altra lingua (livello minimo C1).
- Formazione nel settore agricolo o agroalimentare, con esperienza significativa nella gestione della produzione o in una posizione simile.
- Solide conoscenze dei processi legati all'allevamento, all'approvvigionamento e al benessere animale.
- Capacità di raggiungere obiettivi annuali definiti con rigore e garantire risultati ottimali.
- Leadership naturale, con capacità di motivare e dirigere un team in uno spirito collaborativo.
- Senso di responsabilità e rispetto delle norme di sicurezza sul lavoro.
- Facilità nella gestione di attività che implicano il coordinamento di più siti esterni e il management a distanza.

Cosa offriamo
- Orario di lavoro flessibile Luogo di lavoro flessibile/telelavoro: Fino a 2 giorni di telelavoro possibili.
- Congedo maternità/congedo paternità: 18 settimane di congedo maternità retribuito / 8 settimane di congedo paternità (4 settimane retribuite e 4 settimane non retribuite).
- Prestazioni sociali: 730 giorni di indennità giornaliera in caso di malattia con mantenimento integrale del salario netto.
- Ristorazione: Menu/buffet di mezzogiorno equilibrato al ristorante aziendale per un massimo di CHF 7.-.
- Punti Cumulus: I punti Cumulus sono raddoppiati sui prodotti alimentari e quintuplicati sugli articoli non alimentari.
- Banca Migros: Migros offre tassi di interesse più elevati sui conti privati e sui conti di investimento ai suoi collaboratori.
- Scuola-club Migros: Rimborso del 70% delle spese di corso, fino a un massimo di 1'000 CHF per anno civile.
- Offerta tempo libero e cultura: Benefici di biglietti a prezzo ridotto per eventi culturali selezionati.
- Offerte sport e fitness: Contributo agli abbonamenti fitness: massimo CHF 200.- per abbonamento e per anno.

Contatto
Candidatura e contatto Sabrina Zimmermann 058 571 82 67

Processo di reclutamento
Preselezione delle candidature
Esaminiamo costantemente le candidature ricevute, effettuiamo una preselezione e la trasmettiamo al manager. La decisione di proseguire o eliminare il processo di reclutamento viene comunicata telefonicamente o via e-mail. Tempo di risposta: fino a 3 settimane.

Colloquio con HR e il dipartimento specializzato
Il colloquio si svolge a distanza o in presenza con il responsabile HR e/o il dipartimento specializzato. Serve principalmente per approfondire le competenze personali e professionali e permette a entrambe le parti di valutare la compatibilità culturale con l'azienda e il team. Tempo di risposta: fino a 3 settimane.

Conoscenza del team
Definire la compatibilità di una persona con il team è un fattore importante per il dipendente e il datore di lavoro nella decisione favorevole o sfavorevole all'assunzione. Per questo motivo offriamo a tutti la possibilità di conoscersi meglio in un contesto informale.

Assessment center
L'Assessment center è una parte della procedura di selezione durante il processo di candidatura. Le qualifiche e il comportamento dei candidati vengono analizzati attraverso diverse attività e test. Questo processo può durare un giorno a seconda del dossier. Tempo di risposta: fino a 1 settimana.

Colloquio finale prima della stesura del contratto
Prima di redigere il contratto, conduciamo un colloquio finale per chiarire le domande ancora aperte di entrambe le parti e definire i dettagli contrattuali. Quando tutti i punti sono chiariti, viene presentata un'offerta scritta. Tempo di risposta: fino a 1 settimana.

Offerta e stesura del contratto
I principali punti del contratto vengono verificati nuovamente dopo la nostra offerta di lavoro verbale. La stesura del contratto viene quindi avviata di comune accordo prima di essere inviata per posta. Tempo di risposta: fino a 3 settimane.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about agricultural production and eager to play a key role in the value chain of the poultry division? Join Micarna, a company within the Migros group. Your mission will be to ensure supply, processing, and animal welfare while adhering to legal requirements and the company's strategic objectives.

Responsibilities
- You manage the agricultural sector of the "chickens" value-added chain (breeders, hatchery, fattening) by implementing the defined objectives.
- You ensure the supply of live chickens to the slaughterhouse according to sales needs, respecting legal standards and animal welfare requirements.
- You transform the resources provided in accordance with the company's strategy to optimize results and yields.
- You establish and develop a professional partnership with fatteners and are responsible for animal welfare according to internal guidelines and official standards.
- You set objectives based on customer and company needs.

Requirements
- 5-10 years: Proven experience in a similar position required.
- Completed studies (Uni/EFP, HES, ES): Diploma in agri-food technology or equivalent training.
- French (Good command) German (Very good knowledge): Native French or German speaker with excellent knowledge of the other language (minimum level C1).
- Training in the agricultural or agri-food sector, with significant experience in production management or a similar position.
- Solid knowledge of processes related to breeding, supply, and animal welfare.
- Ability to achieve annual objectives rigorously and ensure optimal results.
- Natural leadership, with the ability to motivate and lead a team in a collaborative spirit.
- Sense of responsibility and respect for workplace safety standards.
- Proficiency in managing activities involving coordination of multiple external sites and remote management.

What We Offer
- Flexible working hours Flexible workplace/remote work: Up to 2 days of remote work possible.
- Maternity leave/paternity leave: 18 weeks of paid maternity leave / 8 weeks of paternity leave (4 weeks paid and 4 weeks unpaid).
- Social benefits: 730 days of daily allowances in case of illness with full net salary maintenance.
- Catering: Balanced lunch menu/buffet at the staff restaurant for a maximum of CHF 7.-.
- Cumulus points: Cumulus points are doubled on food products and quintupled on non-food items.
- Migros Bank: Migros offers higher interest rates on private accounts and investment accounts to its employees.
- Migros Club School: Reimbursement of 70% of course fees, up to a maximum of CHF 1,000 per calendar year.
- Leisure and culture offer: You benefit from discounted tickets for selected cultural events.
- Sports and fitness offers: Contribution to fitness subscriptions: maximum CHF 200.- per subscription per year.

Contact
Application and contact Sabrina Zimmermann 058 571 82 67

Recruitment Process
Preselection of applications
We constantly review received applications, make a preselection, and forward it to the manager. The decision to proceed or eliminate the recruitment process is communicated by phone or email. Response time: up to 3 weeks.

Interview with HR and the specialized department
The interview is conducted remotely or in person with the responsible HR person and/or the specialized department. It primarily serves to learn more about personal and professional skills and allows both parties to evaluate cultural compatibility with the company and the team. Response time: up to 3 weeks.

Team introduction
Defining a person's compatibility with the team is an important factor for the employee and employer in the favorable or unfavorable hiring decision. This is why we offer everyone the opportunity to get to know each other better in an informal setting.

Assessment center
The assessment center is a partial element of the selection procedure during the application process. Candidates' qualifications and behavior are analyzed through various tasks and tests. This process can last a day depending on the file. Response time: up to 1 week.

Final interview before contract drafting
Before drafting the contract, we conduct a final interview to clarify any remaining questions from both parties and settle contractual details. When all points are clarified, a written offer is submitted. Response time: up to 1 week.

Offer and contract drafting
The main points of the contract are reviewed again after our verbal job offer. The contract drafting is then initiated by mutual agreement before being sent by post. Response time: up to 3 weeks.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie leidenschaftlich an der landwirtschaftlichen Produktion interessiert und möchten eine Schlüsselrolle in der Wertschöpfungskette der Geflügeldivision spielen? Werden Sie Teil von Micarna, einem Unternehmen der Migros-Gruppe. Ihre Aufgabe besteht darin, die Versorgung, Verarbeitung und das Tierwohl sicherzustellen, während Sie die gesetzlichen Anforderungen und die strategischen Ziele des Unternehmens einhalten.

Aufgaben
- Sie leiten den landwirtschaftlichen Bereich der Wertschöpfungskette "Hühner" (Elterntiere, Brüterei, Mast) durch die Umsetzung der festgelegten Ziele.
- Sie stellen die Versorgung des Schlachthofs mit lebenden Hühnern gemäß den Verkaufsanforderungen sicher und beachten dabei die gesetzlichen Standards und Anforderungen an das Tierwohl.
- Sie transformieren die bereitgestellten Ressourcen gemäß der Unternehmensstrategie, um Ergebnisse und Erträge zu optimieren.
- Sie etablieren und entwickeln eine professionelle Partnerschaft mit Mastbetrieben und sind verantwortlich für das Tierwohl gemäß internen Richtlinien und geltenden offiziellen Standards.
- Sie setzen Ziele basierend auf den Bedürfnissen der Kunden und des Unternehmens um.

Anforderungen
- 5-10 Jahre: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position erforderlich.
- Abgeschlossene Studien (Uni/EFP, HES, ES): Diplom in Lebensmitteltechnologie oder gleichwertige Ausbildung.
- Französisch (Gute Kenntnisse) Deutsch (Sehr gute Kenntnisse): Muttersprache Französisch oder Deutsch mit ausgezeichneten Kenntnissen der anderen Sprache (mindestens Niveau C1).
- Ausbildung im landwirtschaftlichen oder lebensmitteltechnischen Bereich mit signifikanter Erfahrung im Produktionsmanagement oder einer ähnlichen Position.
- Fundierte Kenntnisse der Prozesse im Zusammenhang mit Tierhaltung, Versorgung und Tierwohl.
- Fähigkeit, jährliche Ziele mit Genauigkeit zu erreichen und optimale Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.
- Natürliche Führungsqualitäten mit der Fähigkeit, ein Team in einem kollaborativen Geist zu motivieren und zu führen.
- Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften.
- Kompetenz in der Verwaltung von Aktivitäten, die die Koordination mehrerer externer Standorte und das Remote-Management umfassen.

Was wir bieten
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten Flexibler Arbeitsort/Homeoffice: Bis zu 2 Tage Homeoffice möglich.
- Mutterschafts-/Vaterschaftsurlaub: 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub / 8 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub (4 Wochen bezahlt und 4 Wochen unbezahlt).
- Sozialleistungen: 730 Tage Krankentagegeld mit vollständiger Nettogehaltserhaltung.
- Verpflegung: Ausgewogenes Mittagsmenü/Buffet im Mitarbeiterrestaurant für maximal CHF 7.-.
- Cumulus-Punkte: Cumulus-Punkte werden auf Lebensmittelprodukte verdoppelt und auf Non-Food-Artikel verfünffacht.
- Migros Bank: Migros bietet seinen Mitarbeitern höhere Zinssätze auf Privatkonten und Anlagekonten.
- Migros Klubschule: Erstattung von 70 % der Kursgebühren, bis zu einem Maximum von CHF 1'000 pro Kalenderjahr.
- Freizeit- und Kulturangebote: Sie profitieren von vergünstigten Tickets für ausgewählte kulturelle Veranstaltungen.
- Sport- und Fitnessangebote: Beitrag zu Fitness-Abonnements: maximal CHF 200.- pro Abonnement und Jahr.

Kontakt
Bewerbung und Kontakt Sabrina Zimmermann 058 571 82 67

Rekrutierungsprozess
Vorauswahl der Bewerbungen
Wir prüfen laufend die eingegangenen Bewerbungen, führen eine Vorauswahl durch und leiten diese an den Manager weiter. Die Entscheidung über die Fortsetzung oder den Abbruch des Rekrutierungsprozesses wird telefonisch oder per E-Mail mitgeteilt. Antwortzeit: bis zu 3 Wochen.

Vorstellungsgespräch mit HR und der Fachabteilung
Das Gespräch wird remote oder persönlich mit der zuständigen HR-Person und/oder der Fachabteilung geführt. Es dient in erster Linie dazu, mehr über persönliche und berufliche Kompetenzen zu erfahren und ermöglicht beiden Parteien, die kulturelle Kompatibilität mit dem Unternehmen und dem Team zu bewerten. Antwortzeit: bis zu 3 Wochen.

Teamvorstellung
Die Definition der Kompatibilität einer Person mit dem Team ist ein wichtiger Faktor für den Mitarbeiter und den Arbeitgeber bei der Entscheidung für oder gegen eine Einstellung. Aus diesem Grund bieten wir allen die Möglichkeit, sich in einem informellen Rahmen besser kennenzulernen.

Assessment Center
Das Assessment Center ist ein Teil der Auswahlverfahren während des Bewerbungsprozesses. Die Qualifikationen und das Verhalten der Kandidaten werden durch verschiedene Aufgaben und Tests analysiert. Dieser Prozess kann je nach Akte einen Tag dauern. Antwortzeit: bis zu 1 Woche.

Abschlussgespräch vor der Vertragsausarbeitung
Vor der Erstellung des Vertrags führen wir ein Abschlussgespräch, um offene Fragen beider Parteien zu klären und vertragliche Details zu regeln. Wenn alle Punkte geklärt sind, wird ein schriftliches Angebot unterbreitet. Antwortzeit: bis zu 1 Woche.

Angebot und Vertragsausarbeitung
Die Hauptpunkte des Vertrags werden nach unserem mündlichen Stellenangebot erneut überprüft. Die Vertragsausarbeitung wird dann einvernehmlich eingeleitet, bevor sie per Post versendet wird. Antwortzeit: bis zu 3 Wochen.

Sie bietet ein attraktives Angebot an Sprach-, Bewegungs- und Kreativitätskursen – dank der Unterstützung des Migros-Kulturprozent. Steh unseren Kursteilnehmenden beim Entfalten ihrer Talente und Erreichung der Lernziele unterstützend zur Seite.

## Mansioni
- Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung des Unterrichts (Deutsch Niveau A1 - C1)
- praxisorientierte Unterrichtsgestaltung nach erwachsenenbildnerischen Kriterien
- Lektionsaufbau unter Berücksichtigung der unterschiedlichen Voraussetzungen der Kursteilnehmenden

- Verfügbarkeit vormittags von 8:30 bis 12:00 Uhr von Montag bis Freitag oder mindestens an zwei Abenden pro Woche von 18:00 bis 22:00 Uhr
- Kundenorientiertes, gepflegtes und freundliches Auftreten
- Selbstständige, flexible und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit
- Freude am Unterrichten in kleinen bis mittelgrossen Gruppen
- Bereitschaft, online oder hybrid zu unterrichten
- Fähigkeit, digitale Medien in den Unterricht einzubinden

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sotto il motto «così vario come te», la Klubschule è il punto di incontro ispiratore per vivere un tempo libero significativo. Offre un'ampia gamma di corsi di lingue, movimento e creatività – grazie al sostegno della percentuale culturale Migros. Supporta i nostri partecipanti ai corsi nello sviluppo dei loro talenti e nel raggiungimento dei loro obiettivi di apprendimento.

Mansioni
- Preparazione, svolgimento e follow-up delle lezioni (livelli di tedesco A1 - C1)
- Progettazione delle lezioni orientata alla pratica secondo criteri di educazione degli adulti
- Strutturazione delle lezioni tenendo conto delle diverse esigenze dei partecipanti ai corsi
- Coordinamento regolare con i tuoi referenti dell'amministrazione della Klubschule
- Partecipazione a corsi di formazione interni della Klubschule Migros

Requisiti
- 2-3 anni di esperienza: in una funzione simile e/o esperienza di insegnamento nell'educazione degli adulti
- Formazione di base o avanzata completata: formazione pedagogica e/o didattica linguistica (ad es. SVEB per insegnanti di corsi di lingua, diploma di insegnamento)
- Tedesco (livello avanzato): insegnante con tedesco come lingua madre: almeno livello Matura. Insegnante con tedesco come lingua straniera: certificato di lingua obiettivo livello C2
- Disponibilità la mattina dalle 8:30 alle 12:00 dal lunedì al venerdì o almeno due sere a settimana dalle 18:00 alle 22:00
- Aspetto orientato al cliente, curato e amichevole
- Personalità autonoma, flessibile e affidabile
- Piacere nell'insegnare a gruppi piccoli o medi
- Disponibilità a insegnare online o in modalità ibrida
- Capacità di integrare i media digitali nell'insegnamento

Cosa offriamo
- Parte del gruppo Migros: Come parte del gruppo Migros, benefici di strutture stabili, numerose opportunità di carriera e vantaggi interessanti
- Luogo di lavoro centrale: Le nostre sedi si trovano in posizioni centrali
- Infrastruttura moderna: Ambiente di lavoro accogliente e funzionale, infrastruttura IT moderna
- Orario di lavoro flessibile: I nostri orari di lavoro flessibili supportano un equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata
- Abbonamento telefonico: Condizioni aziendali agevolate per l'abbonamento telefonico privato
- Prestazioni sociali: Migros offre condizioni di impiego interessanti con ottime prestazioni sociali
- Banca Migros: Conto corrente e di risparmio con tassi di interesse preferenziali e gestione del conto senza spese
- Formazione individuale Cultura del "tu": I nostri valori sono supportati dalla cultura del "tu" vissuta
- Responsabilità e autonomia: Campo di attività vario con un alto grado di responsabilità

Contatto
Candidatura & Contatto
Tina Brødsgaard
Coach della qualità per le lingue

Processo di selezione
Invio della candidatura
Per una candidatura completa abbiamo bisogno del tuo curriculum vitae, dei tuoi certificati e diplomi. Una foto nel curriculum vitae e una lettera motivazionale non sono necessari. Promuoviamo pari opportunità per tutti i candidati. Abbiamo un processo di selezione standardizzato. Se ciò non funziona per te, menzionalo nel tuo dossier di candidatura.

Preselezione delle candidature
Esaminiamo continuamente le candidature ricevute, effettuiamo una preselezione e la sottoponiamo al responsabile per la revisione. La decisione sul proseguimento o l'esclusione dal processo di selezione viene comunicata telefonicamente o via e-mail.
Durata per il feedback: Fino a tre settimane

Colloquio personale via video o telefono
In caso di un gran numero di candidati, effettuiamo facoltativamente un colloquio telefonico o video personale. Questo ci dà la possibilità di conoscere meglio più candidati in breve tempo, per invitare le persone più adatte alla fase successiva.
Durata per il feedback: Fino a una settimana

Colloquio tecnico
In un colloquio tecnico, le conoscenze specifiche rilevanti per l'esecuzione del lavoro vengono valutate dal responsabile e/o da un altro esperto e possibilmente dal team. Se possibile, c'è tempo per conoscere meglio il luogo di lavoro e il team in una conversazione informale.
Durata per il feedback: Fino a tre settimane

Offerta e contratto (digitale)
Dopo la nostra offerta verbale, i punti principali del contratto vengono verificati nuovamente. Dopo l'accordo, la creazione del contratto viene avviata e inviata per la firma digitale via e-mail.
Durata per il feedback: Fino a una settimana
descriptionByLocale.en:
Under the motto "as diverse as you", the Klubschule is the inspiring meeting point to experience meaningful leisure activities. It offers an attractive range of language, movement, and creativity courses – thanks to the support of the Migros Cultural Percentage. Support our course participants in developing their talents and achieving their learning goals.

Responsibilities
- Preparation, delivery, and follow-up of lessons (German levels A1 - C1)
- Practice-oriented lesson design based on adult education principles
- Structuring lessons while considering the diverse needs of course participants
- Regular coordination with your contacts in the Klubschule administration
- Participation in internal training sessions at Klubschule Migros

Requirements
- 2-3 years of experience: in a similar role and/or teaching experience in adult education
- Completed basic or advanced training: pedagogical and/or language didactics training (e.g., SVEB for language course instructors, teaching diploma)
- German (proficient): Teacher with German as a native language: at least Matura level. Teacher with German as a foreign language: Certificate in target language level C2
- Availability in the mornings from 8:30 AM to 12:00 PM from Monday to Friday or at least two evenings per week from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM
- Customer-oriented, well-groomed, and friendly demeanor
- Independent, flexible, and reliable personality
- Enjoyment in teaching small to medium-sized groups
- Willingness to teach online or in a hybrid format
- Ability to integrate digital media into teaching

What We Offer
- Part of the Migros Group: As part of the Migros Group, you benefit from stable structures, diverse career opportunities, and attractive benefits
- Central workplace: Our locations are centrally located
- Modern infrastructure: Inviting and functional office environment, modern IT infrastructure
- Flexible working hours: Our flexible working hours support a balanced work-life balance
- Mobile subscription: Discounted business conditions for private mobile subscriptions
- Social benefits: Migros offers attractive employment conditions with excellent social benefits
- Migros Bank: Private and investment accounts with preferential interest rates and fee-free account management
- Individual further training You-culture: Our values are supported by the lived you-culture
- Responsibility & freedom: Varied field of activity with a high degree of responsibility

Contact
Application & Contact
Tina Brødsgaard
Quality Coach Languages

Recruitment Process
Submit Application
For a complete application, we need your CV, certificates, and diplomas. A photo in the CV and a cover letter are not necessary. We promote equal opportunities for all applicants. We have a standardized recruitment process. If this does not work for you, please mention it in your application documents.

Pre-selection of Applications
We continuously review incoming applications, create a pre-selection, and release it for review by the manager. The decision on whether to proceed or be excluded from the recruitment process will be communicated via phone or email.
Response time: Up to three weeks

Personal Video or Phone Interview
In the case of a large number of applicants, we optionally conduct a personal phone or video interview. This gives us the opportunity to get to know more candidates in a short time to invite suitable individuals to the next round.
Response time: Up to one week

Technical Interview
In a technical interview, specific knowledge relevant to the job's execution is assessed by the manager and/or another expert and possibly the team. If possible, there will be time to get to know the workplace and team better in an informal conversation.
Response time: Up to three weeks

Offer & Contract (Digital)
After our verbal job offer, the main contract points are verified again. After agreement, the contract creation is initiated and sent for digital signature via email.
Response time: Up to one week

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sous la devise « aussi varié que vous », la Klubschule est le point de rencontre inspirant pour vivre des loisirs enrichissants. Elle propose une offre attrayante de cours de langues, de mouvement et de créativité – grâce au soutien du Pourcentage culturel Migros. Soutenez nos participants dans le développement de leurs talents et l'atteinte de leurs objectifs d'apprentissage.

Responsabilités
- Préparation, réalisation et suivi des cours (niveaux d'allemand A1 - C1)
- Conception de cours axée sur la pratique selon les principes de l'éducation des adultes
- Structuration des cours en tenant compte des besoins variés des participants
- Coordination régulière avec vos interlocuteurs de l'administration de la Klubschule
- Participation aux formations internes de la Klubschule Migros

Exigences
- 2-3 ans d'expérience : dans une fonction similaire et/ou expérience d'enseignement dans l'éducation des adultes
- Formation de base ou continue achevée : formation pédagogique et/ou didactique linguistique (par ex. SVEB pour les formateurs en langues, diplôme d'enseignement)
- Allemand (courant) : Enseignant ayant l'allemand comme langue maternelle : niveau Maturité minimum. Enseignant ayant l'allemand comme langue étrangère : Certificat de langue cible niveau C2
- Disponibilité le matin de 8h30 à 12h00 du lundi au vendredi ou au moins deux soirs par semaine de 18h00 à 22h00
- Présentation orientée client, soignée et amicale
- Personnalité autonome, flexible et fiable
- Plaisir à enseigner à des groupes de petite ou moyenne taille
- Volonté d'enseigner en ligne ou en mode hybride
- Capacité à intégrer les médias numériques dans l'enseignement

Ce que nous offrons
- Partie du groupe Migros : En tant que membre du groupe Migros, vous bénéficiez de structures stables, de nombreuses opportunités de carrière et d'avantages attractifs
- Lieu de travail central : Nos sites sont situés à des emplacements centraux
- Infrastructure moderne : Environnement de travail accueillant et fonctionnel, infrastructure informatique moderne
- Horaires de travail flexibles : Nos horaires flexibles soutiennent un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée
- Abonnement mobile : Conditions commerciales avantageuses pour un abonnement mobile privé
- Prestations sociales : Migros offre des conditions d'emploi attractives avec d'excellentes prestations sociales
- Banque Migros : Compte privé et d'épargne avec taux préférentiels et gestion de compte sans frais
- Formation continue individuelle Culture du "tu" : Nos valeurs sont soutenues par la culture du "tu" vécue
- Responsabilité et autonomie : Domaine d'activité varié avec un haut degré de responsabilité

Contact
Candidature & Contact
Tina Brødsgaard
Coach qualité Langues

Processus de recrutement
Soumission de la candidature
Pour une candidature complète, nous avons besoin de votre CV, de vos certificats et diplômes. Une photo dans le CV et une lettre de motivation ne sont pas nécessaires. Nous promouvons l'égalité des chances pour tous les candidats. Nous avons un processus de recrutement standardisé. Si cela ne fonctionne pas pour vous, veuillez le mentionner dans votre dossier de candidature.

Pré-sélection des candidatures
Nous examinons en continu les candidatures reçues, effectuons une pré-sélection et la soumettons au responsable pour examen. La décision de poursuivre ou d'exclure du processus de recrutement sera communiquée par téléphone ou par e-mail.
Délai de réponse : Jusqu'à trois semaines

Entretien personnel par vidéo ou téléphone
En cas de grand nombre de candidats, nous organisons éventuellement un entretien téléphonique ou vidéo personnel. Cela nous permet de mieux connaître plus de candidats en peu de temps afin d'inviter les personnes les plus adaptées à l'étape suivante.
Délai de réponse : Jusqu'à une semaine

Entretien technique
Lors d'un entretien technique, les connaissances spécifiques pertinentes pour l'exécution du poste sont évaluées par le responsable et/ou un autre expert et éventuellement l'équipe. Si possible, il y aura du temps pour mieux connaître le lieu de travail et l'équipe lors d'une conversation informelle.

jobs.description:
Die Operations Technology innerhalb des Migros-Genossenschafts-Bundes erbringt eine Vielzahl von IT-Dienstleistungen für die Migros-Gruppe. Der Bereich Service Management bildet die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren IT-Dienstleistungserbringern, Partnern und Unternehmen hinsichtlich IT Service Management Fähigkeiten und den dazugehörigen Systemen.

## Mansioni
- Erarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von Vorgaben, Standards, Kennzahlen und Prozessen für die ITSM-Landschaft
- Erstellen und Pflegen von Dokumentationen, Schulungen und How-to-do’s im internen Wiki
- Unterstützung beim Aufbau von ServiceNow und der Fachbereiche mittels Aufnahme, Analyse der Anforderungen, sowie Mitwirkung bei Organisation und Durchführung von Schulungen, Trainings
- Du erarbeitest Konzepte, Solution Designs und Proof of Concepts und unterstützt unser Team bei der Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung von ServiceNow-Lösungen
- Erarbeiten von Visualisierungen mit Dashboards und Reports in ServiceNow, PowerBI und PowerApps (inkl. deren Support und Betrieb)

## Requisiti
- Erste Erfahrungen rund um Technologie: oder abgeschlossene Lehre EFZ im Technologie Bereich oder Kenntnisse der agilen Arbeitsweisen (siehe SAFe) sind von Vorteil
- Student*in (Uni/FH/HF): Bachelorstudent*in oder Masterstudent*in (FH/Uni/ETH) in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen
- Du fühlst dich in der Informatik zuhause und interessierst dich für Themen wie Aufbau, Design und Verankerung von Prozessen, Frameworks und Konzepte
- Themen der IT Service Management sind dir nicht fremd und du hast erste erste Kontakte mit PowerBI, PowerApps
- Du bist es gewohnt selbständig und strukturiert vorzugehen und du übernimmst gerne verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeiten
- Du bist eine kommunikative Person mit Flair für Zusammenarbeit und kannst vor Teams stehen und dein Wissen vermitteln
- Deutsch (verhandlungssicher)
- Englisch (sehr gute Kenntnisse)

## Cosa offriamo
- Verpflegung: Exzellente Verpflegung zu günstigen Preisen im Personalrestaurant
- Sport- und Fitnessangebote: Kostenbeteiligung an Abos von über 50 Migros Fitness-/Wellness-/Aquaparks
- Moderne Infrastruktur: Vielfältige Arbeitszonen und moderne Co-Working-Spaces mit fortschrittlicher Ausstattung

descriptionByLocale.it:
La Operations Technology all'interno della Migros-Genossenschafts-Bund fornisce una vasta gamma di servizi IT per il gruppo Migros. L'area Service Management funge da interfaccia tra i nostri fornitori di servizi IT, partner e aziende per quanto riguarda le capacità di IT Service Management e i relativi sistemi. Mansioni - Sviluppo e miglioramento di linee guida, standard, indicatori e processi per il panorama ITSM - Creazione di visualizzazioni con dashboard e report in ServiceNow, PowerBI e PowerApps (incluso supporto e operatività) - Creazione e manutenzione di documentazioni, formazioni e guide pratiche nel wiki interno - Supporto nella configurazione di ServiceNow e dei settori specialistici attraverso la raccolta e l'analisi dei requisiti, nonché la partecipazione all'organizzazione e alla realizzazione di corsi di formazione e training 
• Requisiti - Prime esperienze nel campo della tecnologia: o apprendistato completato EFZ nel settore tecnologico o conoscenze dei metodi di lavoro agili (vedi SAFe) sono un vantaggio - Studente* (Uni/FH/HF): Studente di laurea triennale o magistrale (FH/Uni/ETH) in informatica aziendale, informatica, ingegneria gestionale - Ti senti a tuo agio nell'informatica e sei interessato a temi come la creazione, il design e l'integrazione di processi, framework e concetti - I temi dell'IT Service Management non ti sono estranei e hai avuto i primi contatti con PowerBI, PowerApps - Sei abituato a lavorare in modo autonomo e strutturato e ti piace assumerti responsabilità - Sei una persona comunicativa con un'attitudine alla collaborazione e sei in grado di parlare davanti a un team e trasmettere le tue conoscenze - Tedesco (fluente) - Inglese (ottima conoscenza) 
• Cosa offriamo - Ristorazione: Eccellente ristorazione a prezzi convenienti nel ristorante aziendale - Offerte sportive e fitness: Contributo ai costi per abbonamenti in oltre 50 centri fitness/benessere/parchi acquatici Migros - Infrastruttura moderna: Varie aree di lavoro e spazi di co-working moderni con attrezzature avanzate Contatto Candidatura & Contatto Marcel Guggenbühler Talent Acquisition Partner - LinkedIn Processo di selezione Invio della candidatura Per una candidatura completa abbiamo bisogno del tuo CV, dei tuoi certificati e diplomi. Non sono necessari una foto nel CV né una lettera motivazionale. Promuoviamo l'uguaglianza di opportunità per tutti i candidati. Abbiamo un processo di selezione standardizzato. Se questo non fosse adatto a te, menzionalo nel tuo dossier di candidatura. Preselezione delle candidature Esaminiamo continuamente le candidature ricevute, effettuiamo una preselezione e la sottoponiamo al responsabile per la revisione. La decisione sul proseguimento o l'esclusione dal processo di selezione verrà comunicata telefonicamente o via e-mail. Tempo di risposta: Fino a tre settimane Colloquio con HR e reparto specialistico Il colloquio si svolgerà con la persona responsabile delle risorse umane e/o del reparto specialistico, virtualmente o in loco. L'obiettivo principale è conoscere meglio le competenze personali e professionali e consentire a entrambe le parti di valutare l'idoneità culturale all'azienda e al team. Tempo di risposta: Fino a tre settimane Conoscenza del team Se una persona si adatta al team è un fattore importante per la decisione di assunzione sia per i dipendenti che per i datori di lavoro. In un contesto informale, offriamo quindi l'opportunità a tutti di conoscersi reciprocamente. Offerta e stipula del contratto (digitale) Dopo la nostra offerta di lavoro verbale, i punti principali del contratto verranno nuovamente verificati. Dopo l'accordo, verrà avviata la redazione del contratto e inviata per la firma digitale via e-mail. Tempo di risposta: Fino a una settimana Nota per le agenzie di collocamento Per questa posizione consideriamo esclusivamente candidature dirette.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Operations Technology department within Migros-Genossenschafts-Bund provides a wide range of IT services for the Migros Group. The Service Management area acts as an interface between our IT service providers, partners, and companies regarding IT Service Management capabilities and the associated systems. 
• Responsibilities - Development and enhancement of guidelines, standards, metrics, and processes for the ITSM landscape - Creating visualizations with dashboards and reports in ServiceNow, PowerBI, and PowerApps (including their support and operation) - Creating and maintaining documentation, training materials, and how-to guides in the internal wiki - Supporting the setup of ServiceNow and the specialist areas through requirements gathering, analysis, as well as assisting in organizing and conducting training sessions 
• Requirements - Initial experience in technology: or completed EFZ apprenticeship in the technology field or knowledge of agile working methods (see SAFe) is an advantage - Student* (Uni/FH/HF): Bachelor’s or Master’s student (FH/Uni/ETH) in Business Informatics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering - You feel at home in IT and are interested in topics such as the development, design, and anchoring of processes, frameworks, and concepts - You are familiar with IT Service Management topics and have had initial exposure to PowerBI, PowerApps - You are used to working independently and in a structured manner and enjoy taking on responsible tasks - You are a communicative person with a flair for collaboration and can stand in front of teams to share your knowledge - German (fluent) - English (very good knowledge) 
• What we offer - Catering: Excellent meals at affordable prices in the staff restaurant - Sports and fitness offers: Cost contributions to memberships at over 50 Migros fitness/wellness/aquaparks - Modern infrastructure: Diverse work zones and modern co-working spaces with advanced equipment Contact Application & Contact Marcel Guggenbühler Talent Acquisition Partner - LinkedIn Recruitment process Submit application For a complete application, we need your CV, certificates, and diplomas. A photo in the CV and a cover letter are not necessary. We promote equal opportunities for all applicants. We have a standardized recruitment process. If this does not work for you, please mention it in your application documents. Pre-selection of applications We continuously review incoming applications, create a pre-selection, and release it to the manager for review. The decision on whether to proceed or not in the recruitment process will be communicated via phone or email. Response time: Up to three weeks Interview with HR & specialist department The interview will be conducted with the responsible person from HR and/or the specialist department, either virtually or on-site. The primary goal is to learn more about personal and professional competencies and to allow both parties to assess cultural fit within the company and team. Response time: Up to three weeks Team introduction Whether someone fits into the team is an important factor for both employees and employers when deciding on employment. In an informal setting, we therefore offer the opportunity for everyone to get to know each other. Offer & contract issuance (digital) After our verbal job offer, the main contract points will be verified again. After agreement, the contract will be drafted and sent for digital signature via email. Response time: Up to one week Note for recruitment agencies For this position, we only consider direct applications.

Le département Operations Technology au sein de Migros-Genossenschafts-Bund fournit une large gamme de services informatiques pour le groupe Migros. Le domaine Service Management agit comme une interface entre nos prestataires de services informatiques, partenaires et entreprises en ce qui concerne les capacités de gestion des services informatiques et les systèmes associés. Missions - Élaboration et développement des directives, normes, indicateurs et processus pour le paysage ITSM - Création de visualisations avec des tableaux de bord et des rapports dans ServiceNow, PowerBI et PowerApps (y compris leur support et exploitation) - Rédaction et mise à jour de documentations, formations et guides pratiques dans le wiki interne - Soutien à la mise en place de ServiceNow et des domaines spécialisés via la collecte et l’analyse des exigences, ainsi que la participation à l’organisation et à la réalisation de formations et d’entraînements

Die M-Infoline ist die zentrale Kontaktstelle für Anliegen der Migros Kundinnen und Kunden. Oberste Maxime ist die Kundenzufriedenheit. Mit unserem Anspruch auf höchste Qualität und Performance in der Kundenbetreuung trägt die M-Infoline wesentlich zum Unternehmenserfolg bei.

## Mansioni
- Kompetente und serviceorientierte Entgegennahme und Abwicklung der telefonischen Kundenanfragen, sowie Unterstützung im schriftlichen Kundenkontakt (bspw. Kontaktformular, Chat, WhatsApp) auf Deutsch und Französisch
- Erfassung sowie eigenständige Beantwortung und Lösungsfindung von Kundenanliegen mit Fachstellen zu den vielseitigen Themen der Migros-Welt
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing zu produktspezifischen Themen

- Berufserfahrung: im Call Center oder in einem anderen serviceorientierten Bereich
- Abgeschlossene Berufslehre (EFZ): abgeschlossene Berufslehre, Handelsschule oder Matura
- Deutsch (verhandlungssicher) Französisch (verhandlungssicher): weitere Fremdsprachenkenntnisse von Vorteil
- Bereitschaft zur Samstagarbeit (1–2-mal pro Monat)
- Stilsichere mündliche Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch und Französisch
- Selbstständige und flexible Arbeitsweise mit Freude an effizientem Arbeiten mit kompetenter Lösungsfindung
- Belastbare und kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Flair für Kommunikation

descriptionByLocale.en:
The M-Infoline is the central contact point for inquiries from Migros customers. The top priority is customer satisfaction. With our commitment to the highest quality and performance in customer care, the M-Infoline makes a significant contribution to the company's success.

Responsibilities
- Competent and service-oriented handling of customer inquiries via telephone, as well as support in written customer communication (e.g., contact form, chat, WhatsApp) in German and French
- Recording, independently responding to, and finding solutions for customer concerns with specialized departments on various topics related to the Migros world
- Close collaboration with the marketing department on product-specific topics

Requirements
- Work experience: in a call center or another service-oriented field
- Completed vocational training (EFZ): completed vocational training, commercial school, or high school diploma
- German (fluent) French (fluent): additional foreign language skills are an advantage
- Willingness to work on Saturdays (1–2 times per month)
- Excellent oral communication skills in German and French
- Independent and flexible working style with a passion for efficient work and competent solution finding
- Resilient and customer-oriented personality with a strong flair for communication

What we offer
- Modern infrastructure: Diverse work zones and modern co-working spaces with advanced equipment
- Insurance: Up to 25% discount on various insurances such as car, private liability, household, legal protection, and many more
- Occupational pension: Above-average benefits and three different savings plans tailored to individual life situations
- Cumulus points: Additional Cumulus points in all Migros stores and various subsidiaries
- Club school and leisure facilities: 70% discount on Migros Club School offers, 30% discount for fitness/wellness/aquaparks
- Healthy working: Nursing and rest rooms as well as massage options

Contact
Application & Contact Bélise Useguwe Talent Acquisition Partner - LinkedIn ## Recruitment process Submission of application For a complete application, we need your CV, certificates, and diplomas. A photo in the CV and a motivation letter are not necessary. We promote equal opportunities for all applicants. We have a standardized recruitment process. If this does not work for you, mention it in your application dossier. Preselection of applications We continuously review incoming applications, create a preselection, and release it to the responsible person for review. The decision on whether to proceed or be excluded from the recruitment process is communicated by phone or email. Response time: Up to three weeks Interview with HR & department The interview is conducted with the responsible HR person and/or department, either virtually or on-site. The main focus is to learn more about personal and professional competencies and to give both sides the opportunity to assess cultural fit within the company and team. Response time: Up to three weeks Writing/grammar test This written test usually takes place on-site and is divided into these topics: free writing of a story, formulating a response to a customer, analyzing two customer concerns, and grammar and spelling. For positions where foreign languages are crucial, the respective language is tested. Team introduction Whether someone fits into the team is an important factor for employees and employers in deciding for or against employment. In an informal setting, we therefore offer the opportunity for everyone to get to know each other. Offer & contract issuance (Digital) After our verbal job offer, the main contract points are verified again. After agreement, the contract creation is initiated and sent for digital signature via email. Response time: Up to one week

Wir produzieren Lieblingsprodukte, die begeistern – in der Schweiz und für die Schweiz.

- Einrichten und Bedienen der neusten Generation robotergesteuerter Verpackungsanlagen

- Klubschule Migros: Rückerstattung von 70% der Kosten pro Kurs (max. CHF 1'000 pro Kurs).
- Sport- und Fitnessangebote: Rückerstattung von CHF 200 pro Fitness-Jahresabonnement.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you love technology and robotics? As a machine operator, you will take responsibility for our state-of-the-art packaging systems. Together, we shape the future of packaging technology. Become part of our team and grow with us - your passion meets tomorrow's technology here. We produce favorite products that inspire – in Switzerland and for Switzerland.

Responsibilities
- Setting up and operating the latest generation of robot-controlled packaging systems
- Setting up and operating newly acquired vertical and horizontal flow wrapping machines
- Performing format changes on robotic systems, vertical flow wrapping machines, and related components such as conveyor belts, picker lines, and case packers
- Assisting in programming or modifying system programs

Requirements
- 3 - 5 years: Industry/Production
- Completed vocational training (EFZ): Packaging Technologist or Food Technologist
- Professional experience as a Packaging Technologist or Food Technologist
- You are fascinated by technology and have an interest in developing further and taking on responsibility
- Willingness to work in shifts (early and late shifts)
- German (very good knowledge)

What we offer
- Maternity/Paternity leave: 18 weeks of paid maternity leave (instead of 14 weeks), 4 weeks of paternity leave (instead of 2 weeks).
- Mobile subscription: Discounted mobile subscriptions with Wingo, Digitec, and Sunrise for you and, if needed, for three other people you know.
- Occupational pension: Comprehensive coverage in the Migros pension fund – with excellent and attractive benefits.
- Social benefits: 730 days of sick pay at full net salary.
- Meals: Delicious daily menus at affordable prices.
- Cumulus points: Triple points on food products, sixfold points on all other products.
- Employee offers: Employee Cumulus points, discounted mobile subscriptions, higher interest rates at Migros Bank, contributions for Club School/Fitness, and more.
- Vacation: 5 weeks of vacation for everyone, 6 weeks of vacation from the age of 50, 7 weeks of vacation from the age of 60, option to purchase additional vacation days.
- Migros Club School: Reimbursement of 70% of course costs (max. CHF 1,000 per course).
- Sports and fitness offers: Reimbursement of CHF 200 for an annual fitness subscription.
- Training and development: We actively train employees through internal programs and support external training if needed with time and financial contributions.
- "Du" culture: Hoi, hoi zämä, sali - we use first names!

Contact
Application & Contact Jasmin Nick Recruiter ## Recruitment process Preselection of applications (FFB-Group) We continuously review incoming applications, create a preselection, and release it to the manager for review. The decision on whether to proceed or be excluded from the recruitment process is communicated by phone or email. Interview with HR & technical department (FFB-Group) The interview is conducted with the responsible HR person and/or the technical department, either virtually or on-site. The primary focus is to learn more about personal and technical competencies and provide both sides the opportunity to assess cultural fit within the company and team. Trial work A trial day or half-day provides the opportunity to better understand the future work environment and team members. Conversely, it gives us a chance to assess how well someone fits into the team. Response time: Up to three weeks Offer & contract issuance (FFB-Group) After our verbal job offer, the main contract points are verified again. After agreement, the contract creation is initiated and sent by post. ## Note for recruitment agencies For this position, we only consider direct applications.

Workload: 80-100%

Vous aimez la technologie et la robotique ? En tant qu'opérateur/trice de machines, vous serez responsable de nos systèmes d'emballage ultramodernes. Ensemble, nous façonnons l'avenir de la technologie d'emballage. Rejoignez notre équipe et développez-vous avec nous - votre passion rencontre ici la technologie de demain. Nous produisons des produits préférés qui enthousiasment – en Suisse et pour la Suisse.

Responsabilités
- Configurer et exploiter les systèmes d'emballage robotisés de dernière génération
- Configurer et exploiter les nouvelles machines d'emballage verticales et horizontales
- Effectuer des changements de format sur les systèmes robotisés, les machines d'emballage verticales et les composants associés tels que les convoyeurs, les lignes de prélèvement et les case packers
- Participer à la programmation ou à la modification des programmes des systèmes

Exigences
- 3 - 5 ans : Industrie/Production
- Formation professionnelle achevée (EFZ) : Technologue en emballage ou technologue en alimentation
- Expérience professionnelle en tant que technologue en emballage ou technologue en alimentation
- Vous êtes fasciné(e) par la technologie et avez un intérêt à vous développer et à assumer des responsabilités
- Disponibilité pour le travail en équipe (équipes du matin et du soir)
- Allemand (très bonnes connaissances)

Ce que nous offrons
- Congé maternité/paternité : 18 semaines de congé maternité payé (au lieu de 14 semaines), 4 semaines de congé paternité (au lieu de 2 semaines).
- Abonnement mobile : Abonnements mobiles à prix réduit chez Wingo, Digitec et Sunrise pour vous et, si nécessaire, pour trois autres personnes que vous connaissez.
- Prévoyance professionnelle : Couverture complète dans la caisse de pension Migros – avec des prestations excellentes et attractives.
- Prestations sociales : 730 jours d'indemnités journalières en cas de maladie avec salaire net complet.
- Restauration : Menus quotidiens délicieux à des prix abordables.
- Points Cumulus : Points triples sur les produits alimentaires, points sextuples sur tous les autres produits.
- Offres pour les employés : Points Cumulus pour les employés, abonnements mobiles à prix réduit, taux d'intérêt plus élevés à la Migros Bank, contributions pour les cours/fitness de l'École-club et plus encore.
- Vacances : 5 semaines de vacances pour tous, 6 semaines de vacances à partir de 50 ans, 7 semaines de vacances à partir de 60 ans, possibilité d'acheter des jours de vacances supplémentaires.
- École-club Migros : Remboursement de 70 % des frais par cours (max. CHF 1'000 par cours).
- Offres sportives et fitness : Remboursement de CHF 200 pour un abonnement annuel de fitness.
- Formation et développement : Nous formons activement les employés dans le cadre de programmes internes et soutenons, si nécessaire, des formations externes avec des contributions en temps et en argent.
- Culture du "tu" : Hoi, hoi zämä, sali - nous utilisons le tutoiement !

Contact
Candidature & Contact Jasmin Nick Recruiter ## Processus de recrutement Pré-sélection des candidatures (FFB-Group) Nous examinons continuellement les candidatures reçues, effectuons une pré-sélection et la soumettons au responsable pour examen. La décision de poursuivre ou d'être exclu du processus de recrutement est communiquée par téléphone ou par e-mail. Entretien avec les RH & le département technique (FFB-Group) L'entretien est mené avec la personne responsable des RH et/ou le département technique, soit virtuellement, soit sur place. L'objectif principal est de mieux connaître les compétences personnelles et techniques et de donner aux deux parties la possibilité d'évaluer l'adéquation culturelle avec l'entreprise et l'équipe. Travail d'essai Une journée ou demi-journée d'essai offre l'opportunité de mieux comprendre l'environnement de travail futur et les membres de l'équipe. Et inversement, cela nous donne la possibilité d'évaluer à quel point quelqu'un s'intègre bien dans l'équipe. Délai de réponse : Jusqu'à trois semaines Offre & émission du contrat (FFB-Group) Après notre offre orale, les principaux points du contrat sont vérifiés à nouveau. Après accord, la création du contrat est initiée et envoyée par courrier. ## Note pour les agences de recrutement Pour ce poste, nous ne considérons que les candidatures directes.

Taux d'activité : 80-100%

Processo di reclutamento
Selezione preliminare delle candidature (FFB-Group)

Prova pratica
Una giornata o mezza giornata di prova offre l'opportunità di conoscere meglio l'ambiente di lavoro futuro e i membri del team. Allo stesso tempo, ci consente di valutare quanto bene qualcuno si adatti al team.

Tempo di risposta: fino a tre settimane

descriptionByLocale.en:
We ensure that favorite products are created – in Switzerland and for Switzerland. As a machine operator, you will be responsible for the timely production of products. With your knowledge and skills, we supply our Migros customers with our high-quality convenience products.

Responsibilities
- Operate, set up, and control production and packaging machines
- Identify and resolve malfunctions
- Instruct and supervise assigned personnel on the machines
- Responsibility for quality and compliance with guidelines

Requirements
- 2 - 3 years of professional experience: in the food industry
- Completed vocational training (EFZ): in the food industry
- Willingness to work shifts (2-shift system) from Monday to Friday plus occasional Saturdays
- High awareness of quality and hygiene
- Technical understanding
- German (good knowledge)

What we offer
- Maternity/paternity leave: 18 weeks of paid maternity leave (instead of 14 weeks), 4 weeks of paternity leave (instead of 2 weeks).
- Cumulus points: triple points on food, six times the points on all other products.
- Meals: delicious daily menus at affordable prices.
- Occupational pension: fully covered by the Migros pension fund – with excellent and attractive benefits.
- Mobile subscription: discounted mobile subscriptions with Wingo, Digitec, and Sunrise for you and, if needed, for three other people you know.
- Employee benefits: employee Cumulus points, discounted mobile subscriptions, higher interest rates at Migros Bank, contributions for Klubschule/fitness courses, and more.
- Vacation: 5 weeks of vacation for everyone, 6 weeks of vacation from the age of 50, 7 weeks of vacation from the age of 60, with the option to purchase additional vacation days.
- Klubschule Migros: reimbursement of 70% of course costs (max. CHF 1,000 per course).
- Training and development: we actively train employees through internal programs and support external training courses with time and financial contributions if needed.
- Sports and fitness offers: reimbursement of CHF 200 for an annual fitness subscription.
- "Du" culture: Hoi, hoi zämä, sali - we are on a first-name basis!

Contact
Application & Contact
Jasmin Nick
Recruiter

Recruitment process
Pre-selection of applications (FFB-Group)
We continuously review incoming applications, create a pre-selection, and forward it to the responsible manager for review. The decision on whether to proceed or not in the recruitment process will be communicated by phone or email.

Interview with HR & technical department (FFB-Group)
The interview will be conducted with the responsible HR person and/or the technical department, either virtually or on-site. The primary goal is to learn more about personal and technical skills and to give both sides the opportunity to assess the cultural fit within the company and team.

Trial work
A trial day or half-day provides the opportunity to get to know the future work environment and team members better. Conversely, it gives us a chance to assess how well someone fits into the team.

Response time: up to three weeks

Offer & contract issuance (FFB-Group)
After our verbal job offer, the main contract points are verified again. After agreement, the contract creation is initiated and sent by post.

We produce favorite products that inspire – in Switzerland and for Switzerland. Do you enjoy facing new challenges every day and are you looking for a job where you can make a difference? At Pasta Buchs, we are looking for a motivated, duty-conscious, and flexible personality as a Logistician to strengthen our logistics team. Become part of Migros Industry.

Tasks
- Goods receipt, goods control, and storage of raw and packaging materials as well as booking in the SAP system
- Picking of produced finished goods
- Monitoring the palletizing system
- Correct and punctual ensuring of rail and truck loading

Requirements
- 1 - 3 years: Logistics
- Completed vocational apprenticeship (EFZ): Logistics
- Team player, duty-conscious and resilient personality
- Independent and reliable way of working as well as structured thinking and acting
- Suva-recognized forklift license
- Willingness to work in 2 - 3 shifts: 5:00 AM - 1:30 PM (Early), 1:30 PM - 10:00 PM (Late), and 10:00 PM - 5:30 AM (Night)
- Mastery of common Office tools as well as good SAP knowledge or the willingness to learn it
- German (good knowledge)

What we offer
- Maternity leave / Paternity leave: 18 weeks of paid maternity leave (instead of 14 weeks), 4 weeks of paternity leave (instead of 2 weeks).
- Social benefits: 730 days of sickness benefit at full net salary.
- Cumulus points: 3x points on food, 6x points on all other products.
- Employee offers: Cumulus employee points, discounted mobile subscriptions, higher interest rates at Migros Bank, contributions to Club School/Fitness and more.
- Migros Bank: Higher interest rates on personal investment accounts at Migros Bank.
- Mobile subscription: Discounted mobile subscriptions at Wingo, Digitec, and Sunrise for you and, if needed, for three other people you know.
- Occupational pension: Comprehensively secured in the Migros Pension Fund – with first-class and attractive benefits.
- Vacation: 5 weeks of vacation for everyone, 6 weeks of vacation from age 50, 7 weeks of vacation from age 60, purchase of additional vacation days possible.
- Sports and fitness offers: Reimbursement of CHF 200 per annual fitness subscription.
- Education and training: We actively train employees within the framework of internal programs and support external further education with time and financial benefits if necessary.
- "Du-Kultur": Hi, hi everyone – we are on a first-name basis!

Contact
Application & Contact Jasmin Nick Recruiter ## Recruitment Process Pre-selection of applications (FFB-Group) We continuously review incoming applications, create a pre-selection, and release them to the manager for review. The decision on proceeding or withdrawing from the recruitment process is communicated by phone or email. Interview with HR & Specialist Department (FFB-Group) The interview is conducted virtually or on-site with the responsible person from HR and/or the specialist department. This is primarily about learning more about personal and professional competencies and gives both sides the opportunity to assess the cultural fit into the company and team. Trial work A trial day or half-day gives the opportunity to get to know the future working environment and team members better. And vice versa, it gives us a chance to assess how well someone fits into the team. Time for feedback: Up to three weeks Offer & Contract Issuance (FFB-Group) After our verbal job offer, the most important contract points are verified again. Upon agreement, the contract creation is commissioned and sent by post. ## Note for personnel service providers For this position, we only consider direct applications.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Wir produzieren Lieblingsprodukte, die begeistern – in der Schweiz und für die Schweiz. Du stellst dich gerne täglich neuen Herausforderungen und suchst eine Arbeit, bei der du etwas bewegen kannst? In der Pasta Buchs suchen wir als Verstärkung in unserem Logistik-Team eine motivierte, pflichtbewusste und flexible Persönlichkeit als Logistiker*in. Werde Teil der Migros-Industrie.

Mansioni
- Warenannahme, Warenkontrolle und Wareneinlagerung der Roh-und Packmaterialien sowie Verbuchung im SAP-System
- Kommissionierung der produzierten Fertigwaren
- Überwachen der Palettierungsanlage
- Korrekte und pünktliche Sicherstellung von Bahn- und Lastwagenverlad

Requisiti
- 1 - 3 Jahre: Logistik
- Abgeschlossene Berufslehre (EFZ): Logistik
- Teamplayer, pflichtbewusste und belastbare Persönlichkeit
- Selbständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise sowie strukturiertes Denken und Handeln
- Suva anerkannter Staplerausweis
- Bereitschaft für Arbeit in 2 - 3 Schichten: 5.00-13.30 Uhr (Früh) und 13.30-22.00 Uhr (Spät) und 22.00-5.30 Uhr (Nacht)
- Beherrschung der gängigen Office-Tools sowie gute SAP-Kenntnisse oder die Bereitschaft, dies zu erlernen
- Deutsch (gute Kenntnisse)

Cosa offriamo
- Mutterschaftsurlaub / Vaterschaftsurlaub: 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub (anstatt 14 Wochen), 4 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub (anstatt 2 Wochen).
- Sozialleistungen: 730 Tage Krankentaggeld bei vollem Nettolohn.
- Cumulus-Punkte: 3-fache Punkte auf Lebensmittel, 6-fache Punkte auf alle anderen Produkte.
- Mitarbeiterangebote: Mitarbeiterpunkte Cumulus, Vergünstigte Mobileabos, Höhere Zinssätze Migros Bank, Beiträge Klubschule/Fitness und mehr.
- Migros Bank: Höhere Zinssätze auf Personalanlagekonti bei der Migros Bank.
- Handy-Abo: Vergünstigte Handy-Abos bei Wingo, Digitec und Sunrise für dich und bei Bedarf für drei weitere Personen, die du kennst.
- Berufliche Vorsorge: Umfassend abgesichert in der Migros-Pensionskasse – mit erstklassigen und attraktiven Leistungen.
- Ferien: 5 Wochen Ferien für alle, 6 Wochen Ferien ab 50. Altersjahr, 7 Wochen Ferien ab 60. Altersjahr, Zukauf von zusätzlichen Ferientagen möglich.
- Sport- und Fitnessangebote: Rückerstattung von CHF 200 pro Fitness-Jahresabonnement.
- Aus- und Weiterbildung: Wir bilden Mitarbeitende aktiv im Rahmen interner Programme aus und unterstützen bei Bedarf externe Weiterbildungen mit Zeit- und Geldleistungen.
- Du-Kultur: Hoi, hoi zämä, sali - wir sind per Du!

Contatto
Bewerbung & Kontakt Jasmin Nick Recruiter ## Rekrutierungsprozess Vorselektion der Bewerbungen (FFB-Group) Eingegangene Bewerbungen prüfen wir laufend, erstellen eine Vorselektion und geben diese der Führungsperson zur Ansicht frei. Der Entscheid über das Weiterkommen oder Ausscheiden aus dem Rekrutierungsprozess wird per Telefon oder E-Mail kommuniziert. Gespräch mit HR & Fachabteilung (FFB-Group) Das Gespräch wird mit der zuständigen Person aus dem HR und/oder der Fachabteilung virtuell oder vor Ort durchgeführt. Dabei geht es in erster Linie darum, mehr über die Personal- und Fachkompetenzen zu erfahren und gibt beiden Seiten die Möglichkeit, den kulturellen Fit ins Unternehmen und Team zu beurteilen. Probearbeiten Ein Schnuppertag oder -halbtag gibt die Möglichkeit das zukünftige Arbeitsumfeld und die Teammitglieder besser kennenzulernen. Und umgekehrt gibt es uns eine Chance einzuschätzen, wie gut jemand in das Team passt. Dauer bis Rückmeldung: Bis zu drei Wochen Angebot & Vertragsausstellung (FFB-Group) Nach unserem mündlichen Stellenangebot werden die wichtigsten Vertragspunkte nochmals verifiziert. Nach Übereinkunft wird die Vertragserstellung in Auftrag gegeben und per Post versendet. ## Hinweis für Personaldienstleister Für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous produisons des produits favoris qui enthousiasment – en Suisse et pour la Suisse. Vous aimez relever de nouveaux défis au quotidien et vous recherchez un travail où vous pouvez faire bouger les choses ? Chez Pasta Buchs, nous recherchons, pour renforcer notre équipe logistique, une personnalité motivée, consciencieuse et flexible en tant que logisticien/ne. Rejoignez l'Industrie Migros.

Missions
- Réception des marchandises, contrôle des marchandises et stockage des matières premières et des matériaux d'emballage, ainsi que saisie dans le système SAP
- Préparation de commandes des produits finis fabriqués
- Surveillance de l'installation de palettisation
- Garantie correcte et ponctuelle du chargement des trains et des camions

Profil recherché
- 1 - 3 ans : Logistique
- Apprentissage professionnel terminé (CFC) : Logistique
- Esprit d'équipe, personnalité consciencieuse et résistante au stress
- Méthode de travail autonome et fiable, ainsi que pensée et action structurées
- Permis de cariste reconnu par la Suva
- Disponibilité pour le travail en 2 - 3 équipes : 5h00-13h30 (matin), 13h30-22h00 (après-midi) et 22h00-5h30 (nuit)
- Maîtrise des outils Office courants ainsi que de bonnes connaissances de SAP ou volonté de les apprendre
- Allemand (bonnes connaissances)

Ce que nous offrons
- Congé maternité / congé paternité : 18 semaines de congé maternité payé (au lieu de 14 semaines), 4 semaines de congé paternité (au lieu de 2 semaines).
- Prestations sociales : 730 jours d'indemnités journalières de maladie avec le plein salaire net.
- Points Cumulus : points triplés sur les produits alimentaires, points sextuplés sur tous les autres produits.
- Offres pour les collaborateurs : points Cumulus pour les collaborateurs, abonnements mobiles à prix réduit, taux d'intérêt plus élevés à la Banque Migros, contributions à l'École-club/Fitness et plus encore.
- Banque Migros : taux d'intérêt plus élevés sur les comptes de placement du personnel à la Banque Migros.
- Abonnement mobile : abonnements mobiles à prix réduit chez Wingo, Digitec et Sunrise pour vous et, si nécessaire, pour trois autres personnes de votre connaissance.
- Prévoyance professionnelle : couverture complète dans la Caisse de pensions Migros – avec des prestations de premier ordre et attrayantes.
- Vacances : 5 semaines de vacances pour tous, 6 semaines de vacances à partir de 50 ans, 7 semaines de vacances à partir de 60 ans, possibilité d'acheter des jours de vacances supplémentaires.
- Offres de sport et de fitness : remboursement de CHF 200 par abonnement annuel de fitness.
- Formation initiale et continue : nous formons activement nos collaborateurs dans le cadre de programmes internes et soutenons, si nécessaire, les formations continues externes par des prestations en temps et en argent.
- Culture du tutoiement : Salut, salut à tous – nous nous tutoyons !

Contact
Candidature & Contact Jasmin Nick Recruteuse ## Processus de recrutement Présélection des candidatures (FFB-Group) Nous examinons les candidatures reçues en continu, effectuons une présélection et les transmettons au responsable pour examen. La décision concernant la suite ou l'exclusion du processus de recrutement est communiquée par téléphone ou par e-mail. Entretien avec les RH et le département spécialisé (FFB-Group) L'entretien se déroule virtuellement ou sur place avec la personne responsable des RH et/ou du département spécialisé. Il s'agit avant tout d'en savoir plus sur les compétences personnelles et professionnelles et cela donne aux deux parties l'occasion d'évaluer l'adéquation culturelle avec l'entreprise et l'équipe. Travail à l'essai Une journée ou une demi-journée d'essai permet de mieux connaître le futur environnement de travail et les membres de l'équipe. Et inversement, cela nous donne une chance d'évaluer dans quelle mesure quelqu'un s'intègre dans l'équipe. Délai de réponse : jusqu'à trois semaines Offre & établissement du contrat (FFB-Group) Après notre offre d'emploi verbale, les points principaux du contrat sont à nouveau vérifiés. Après accord, l'établissement du contrat est commandé et envoyé par la poste. ## Remarque pour les prestataires de services de personnel Pour ce poste, nous ne prenons en compte que les candidatures directes.

jobs.description:
Die Klubschule Migros ist die grösste Anbieterin für Erwachsenenbildung in der Schweiz. Die Genossenschaft Migros Ostschweiz betreibt 7 Klubschulen, in denen unseren Kunden über 600 verschiedene Kurse und Lehrgänge in einer angenehmen Unterrichtsatmosphäre angeboten werden.

## Mansioni
- Deine Freude am Unterrichten, dein Engagement und dein gewinnendes Auftreten begeistern die Teilnehmenden
- Die umfassende Vor- und Nachbereitung des Unterrichts gehört ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben
- Durch regelmässige Absprachen mit den zuständigen Ansprechpersonen der Klubschuladministration gewährleistest du eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit

- Du kommunizierst klar, effektiv und respektvoll
- Du zeichnest dich durch Selbstreflexion und Empathie gegenüber den Teilnehmenden aus
- Idealerweise verfügst du über das SVEB-Zertifikat 1 oder einen gleichwertigen Abschluss
- Deutsch (sehr gute Kenntnisse)

- Versicherungen: Vorteilskonditionen bei diversen Versicherungsgesellschaften
- Cumulus-Punkte: Mehrfach Cumulus-Punkte auf Food- und Nonfood-Artikel

jobs.description:
Unter dem Motto «So vielfältig wie du» ist die Klubschule der inspirierende Treffpunkt, um sinnstiftende Freizeitgestaltung zu erleben. Sie bietet ein attraktives Angebot an Sprach-, Bewegungs- und Kreativitätskursen – dank der Unterstützung des Migros-Kulturprozent. Steh unseren Kursteilnehmenden beim Entfalten ihrer Talente und Erreichung der Lernziele unterstützend zur Seite.

## Mansioni
- Vorbereitung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung des Unterrichts
- Lektionsaufbau unter Berücksichtigung der unterschiedlichen Voraussetzungen der Kursteilnehmenden
- Regelmässige Absprache mit deinen Ansprechpersonen der Klubschuladministration

- Abbonamento telefonico: Condizioni aziendali agevolate per abbonamenti telefonici privati
- Banca Migros: Conto privato e di investimento con interessi preferenziali e gestione del conto senza spese
- Ampia offerta di formazione: Generosa offerta di corsi di formazione interni gratuiti, partecipazione gratuita a corsi selezionati (lingue nazionali e corsi di salute) e contributo finanziario all'offerta complessiva dei corsi

Contatto
Candidatura e contatto Barbara Wapf Coach della qualità

Processo di reclutamento
Invio della candidatura Per una candidatura completa abbiamo bisogno del tuo curriculum vitae, dei tuoi certificati e diplomi. Una foto nel curriculum vitae e una lettera di motivazione non sono necessarie. Promuoviamo l'uguaglianza di opportunità per tutti i candidati. Abbiamo un processo di reclutamento standardizzato. Se questo non funziona per te, menzionalo nel tuo dossier di candidatura.

Preselezione delle candidature Le candidature ricevute vengono esaminate continuamente, viene effettuata una preselezione e questa viene sottoposta alla persona responsabile per la visione. La decisione sul proseguimento o sull'esclusione dal processo di reclutamento viene comunicata telefonicamente o via e-mail. Tempo di risposta: Fino a tre settimane

Questo ci dà la possibilità di conoscere meglio più candidati in breve tempo, per invitare le persone adatte alla fase successiva. Tempo di risposta: Fino a una settimana

Under the motto «As diverse as you», Klubschule is the inspiring meeting point to experience meaningful leisure activities. It offers an attractive range of language, movement, and creativity courses – thanks to the support of Migros Culture Percentage. Support our course participants in developing their talents and achieving their learning goals.

Responsibilities
- Preparation, execution, and follow-up of lessons
- Structuring lessons while considering the diverse needs of course participants
- Regular coordination with your contacts in Klubschule administration
- Participation in training sessions

Requirements
- Proven teaching experience in adult education: in the relevant field or a comparable role
- Completed basic or advanced training: Diploma in dance instruction
- Customer-oriented, well-groomed, and courteous demeanor
- Independent, flexible, and reliable personality
- Convey expertise in a varied, participant- and goal-oriented manner while inspiring enthusiasm
- German (good knowledge)

What we offer
- Part of the Migros Group: As part of the Migros Group, you benefit from stable structures, diverse career opportunities, and attractive benefits
- Central workplace: Our locations are centrally situated
- Flexible working hours: Our flexible working hours support a balanced work-life harmony
- Mobile subscription: Discounted business conditions for private mobile subscriptions
- Migros Bank: Private and investment accounts with preferential interest rates and fee-free account management
- Diverse training opportunities: Generous offering of free internal training, free participation in selected courses (national languages and health courses), and financial contribution to the overall course offerings

Contact
Application & Contact Barbara Wapf Quality Coach

Recruitment process
Submitting application For a complete application, we require your CV, certificates, and diplomas. A photo in the CV and a motivation letter are not necessary. We promote equal opportunities for all applicants. We have a standardized recruitment process. If this does not work for you, please mention it in your application dossier.

Preselection of applications Received applications are continuously reviewed, a preselection is made, and forwarded to the responsible person for review. The decision on whether to proceed or exit the recruitment process is communicated by phone or email. Response time: Up to three weeks

Personal phone or video interview In case of a large number of applicants, we optionally conduct a personal phone or video interview. This allows us to better get to know more candidates in a short time to invite suitable individuals to the next round. Response time: Up to one week

Technical interview In a technical interview, specific knowledge relevant to the job execution is assessed by the responsible person and/or another expert and possibly the team. If possible, there is time to get to know the workplace and team better in an informal conversation. Response time: Up to three weeks

Offer & contract issuance (digital) After our verbal job offer, the main contract points are verified again. After agreement, the contract creation is initiated and sent for digital signature via email. Response time: Up to one week

- Transmettre des connaissances de manière variée, orientée vers les participants et les objectifs, tout en suscitant l'enthousiasme
- Allemand (bonnes connaissances)

Ce que nous offrons
- Partie du groupe Migros : En tant que membre du groupe Migros, vous bénéficiez de structures stables, d'opportunités de carrière diversifiées et d'avantages attractifs
- Lieu de travail central : Nos sites sont situés dans des emplacements centraux
- Horaires de travail flexibles : Nos horaires flexibles favorisent un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée
- Abonnement mobile : Conditions commerciales avantageuses pour les abonnements mobiles privés
- Banque Migros : Comptes privés et d'investissement avec taux préférentiels et gestion de compte sans frais
- Offre de formation diversifiée : Offre généreuse de formations internes gratuites, participation gratuite à des cours sélectionnés (langues nationales et cours de santé), et contribution financière à l'offre globale de cours

Candidature & Contact Barbara Wapf Coach Qualité

La décision de poursuivre ou de quitter le processus de recrutement est communiquée par téléphone ou par e-mail. Délai de réponse : Jusqu'à trois semaines

- Keine Aus-/Weiterbildung gefordert

Dietro le quinte per garantire che il nostro negozio funzioni? Benvenuto/a nel team vincente e fresco. Senza logistica, da noi non funziona nulla. È il collo di bottiglia, il booster di efficienza e il cuore pulsante in uno. Qui abbiamo bisogno di veri professionisti come te. Denner. Questo è il nostro negozio.

Mansioni
- Pianificare gli ordini dei punti vendita utilizzando il programma di pianificazione dei percorsi
- Registrare e coordinare gli ordini giornalieri, nonché preparare i documenti di consegna
- Garantire un flusso di informazioni tempestivo e senza intoppi ai nostri punti vendita e ai nostri autisti
- Rispondere e gestire le richieste di clienti e fornitori relative ai trasporti
- Supportare il coordinamento operativo in caso di modifiche alla pianificazione dei percorsi
- Svolgere attività amministrative generali

Requisiti
- Almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale in una funzione simile
- Formazione di base o avanzata completata nel settore dei trasporti
- Conoscenze geografiche comprovate della Svizzera tedesca e del Ticino
- Disponibilità a lavorare su turni tra le 03:30 e le 19:00 (lun-sab)
- Spirito di squadra con buone capacità comunicative
- Buona conoscenza di MS Office (Excel) e preferibilmente del modulo TM di SAP S4/HANA
- Tedesco (fluente)
- Italiano (preferibile)

Cosa offriamo
- Migros Bank: Condizioni vantaggiose su interessi e commissioni per i conti privati, di investimento o ipotecari.
- Abbonamento telefonico: La scelta è tua: con Galaxus Mobile, Wingo o Sunrise, a partire da CHF 10.-, sempre connesso nel modo giusto.
- Offerte per il tempo libero e la cultura: Sconti su noleggio auto, hotel, eventi e molto altro.
- Formazione personalizzata: Formazione interna e supporto finanziario per corsi di formazione esterni utili.
- Responsabilità e autonomia: Tanto spazio per le tue idee e per fare la differenza insieme a noi.
- Vacanze: 6 settimane di ferie per tutti e giorni aggiuntivi per gli anniversari di servizio.

Contatto
Candidatura e contatto
Fabienne Tschantré

Processo di selezione
Colloquio con HR e reparto tecnico
Il colloquio si svolgerà con la persona responsabile delle risorse umane e/o del reparto tecnico, in modalità virtuale o in presenza. L'obiettivo principale è conoscere meglio le competenze personali e professionali e dare a entrambe le parti l'opportunità di valutare l'idoneità culturale all'azienda e al team.
Tempo di risposta: Fino a tre settimane

Prova pratica
Una giornata o mezza giornata di prova offre l'opportunità di conoscere meglio l'ambiente di lavoro futuro e i membri del team. Allo stesso tempo, ci consente di valutare quanto bene qualcuno si adatti al team.
Tempo di risposta: Fino a tre settimane

Colloquio finale prima dell'offerta contrattuale
Prima dell'emissione del contratto, conduciamo un colloquio finale per chiarire eventuali domande aperte da entrambe le parti e definire i dettagli contrattuali. Una volta chiariti tutti i punti, segue l'offerta scritta.
Tempo di risposta: Fino a una settimana

Offerta e emissione del contratto
Dopo la nostra offerta verbale, i punti principali del contratto vengono nuovamente verificati. Una volta raggiunto l'accordo, la redazione del contratto viene avviata e inviata per posta.
Tempo di risposta: Fino a tre settimane

Nota per le agenzie di collocamento
Per questa posizione consideriamo esclusivamente candidature dirette.
